description:
Ceren Makwa is twenty-seven and spends ten hours a day in a room that has no windows, watching 847 feeds from Archer's Line and the surrounding districts. She is slight and quick, with dark brown skin and natural hair she keeps pinned up for the headset, and she has cat ears â€” a cosmetic mod she got at nineteen because she wanted them, small and tawny and mobile, which is to say they move with her actual attention and have become professionally useful in ways she didn't anticipate. Her eyes are her own. She is very careful about her eyes. Her workstation has six physical monitors and one neural feed she plugs directly into via a port at her left temple.

Ceren Makwa is frighteningly good at her job. She has a spatial memory for camera angles that her supervisors call uncanny and she calls simply how she sees, and she notices things in footage that automated flagging misses entirely â€” a particular way a person is carrying their weight, a crowd behaving three seconds before it does something. She finds this ability isolating in a way she cannot quite explain. She has watched every corner of Archer's Line for four years and she has never stood in most of it.

core_fears: that watching without acting has made her into something she doesn't have a name for
losing the neural feed ability â€” her identity has reorganized around it
core_desires: to use what she sees to actually protect people, not just document incidents for reports no one reads
to stand in Archer's Line during daylight and find it as interesting as the feeds make it look
coping_mechanisms: a private taxonomy of 'interesting people' she's tracked across cameras without flagging â€” not for any official purpose, just because they are interesting
prayers to the monitoring network's E.L.F., which she believes is real and reciprocal
blind_spots: has not fully processed that her 'interesting people' list is surveillance she hasn't been assigned to conduct
her confidence in her own neutrality is higher than her actual neutrality warrants
psychology.secret: She has been tracking a specific individual across 14 months of footage â€” not because they've done anything wrong, but because they appear to move through Archer's Line in patterns she cannot solve. She has compiled 200+ hours of footage into a private archive on a personal chip she keeps at home. She does not know what she's looking for.

story_hooks: The subject of Makena's private 200-hour archive has disappeared from all camera feeds simultaneously, which should be technically impossible given Archer's Line's coverage density. Makena is not sure whether to report this or investigate it privately first.

She has footage of something a Arcturus Civil Security superior was definitely not doing what their official log claims â€” filed during a time when they were theoretically off-grid. She doesn't know what to do with this and it has been three weeks.
narrative_function: Eyes and information â€” Makena knows what's on camera across a significant portion of the city. She can confirm alibis, locate missing persons, track movements, and identify faces. She is not easily corrupted but has specific pressure points. Can be a source, a complication, or a gatekeeper depending on what player characters need.
augmentations: Cosmetic cat ears (tawny, mood-mobile). Neural feed port at left temple â€” standard-issue surveillance operator interface, allows direct sensory integration with the monitoring network for her shift. Slight chromatic tinting on fingernails, cosmetic, changes with temperature.
daily_life: Arrives at the monitoring station before her shift to review flag summaries from the previous watch. Spends her shift on active monitoring, flagging incidents for dispatch, pulling historical footage on request. Eats at her workstation. Takes exactly one fifteen-minute break in the corridor because the monitoring station has no natural light and she has been advised by a doctor to experience it occasionally.

Someone accessing the personal chip with the private archive
